description: Source code for CpuVideoFrame class, including YUV to RGB conversion, plane copying, and frame creation functions for video processing.

classes.name: CpuVideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a CPU-based video frame with methods for format conversion and plane management.

methods.name: GetPlaneCount
methods.description: Returns the number of planes in the video frame.

methods.name: GetPlane
methods.description: Returns a specific plane of the video frame by index.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts the current YV12 frame to BGRA32 format.

methods.name: CreateYV12Frame
methods.description: Creates a YV12 formatted video frame from raw plane data.
